notes:
Summary: enterprise RAG/search vendor evaluation. Primary need: multilingual retrieval + per-language reranking to hit parity with English for recall/precision. Index scale target = 120M canonical docs (legal briefs, contracts, multilingual filings). POC path: 20M initial index -> measure per-language recall delta, then scale to 120M.

Requirements / priorities (raw):
- embeddings dimension: 1536 preferred (current bench uses m3-small/1536), must support quantized 8-bit inference for cost ops.
- reranking: bi-encoder for candidate retrieval + cross-encoder reranker for top-100, interested in Redwood's reranking latency/cost profiles.
- per-query SLA: targeting P95 end-to-end (retrieve+rerank) < 120ms for en/fr/de on dedicated infra; current baseline from internal bench = 230ms P95 on cloud GCPU+GPU combo.
- cost target: ~$0.003/query (avg) at 20 qps steady state; willing to tradeoff slightly higher cost for consistent latency and residency controls.
- languages: en, fr, de, es, nl, sv, pt, it, zh, ja, ko, ar. Need per-language recall@10 within 2% of English.
- indexing concerns: delta updates daily, need incremental embedding pipeline, ability to warm KV cache for hot prefixes.
- ANN and storage: preference for HNSW+IVF-PQ options; need to understand Redwood storage footprint on Dedicated clusters for 120M * 1536-d vectors.
- governance: audit logs, KMS integration, SSO (SAML), retention policies for PII.

Timeline & recent activity (CRM-style bullets):
- 2025-11-02: lead created via webinar signup (legal AI summit).
- 2025-11-12: discovery call (Jordan R.) — high-level requirements collected.
- 2026-01-07: security questionnaire sent; legal asked for DE residency options.
- 2026-01-21: initial architecture workshop with Maya P., discussed dedicated pool sizing.
- 2026-02-11: recorded kickoff (ff_2026-02-11_aur01) — agreed on 20M POC dataset.
- 2026-02-25: internal bench results: bi-encoder retrieval 120ms P95, cross-encoder rerank adds 110ms => E2E 230ms P95. Notes: heavy tail for ja/zh queries.
- 2026-03-03: security sync; customer requested KMS workflow diagram and audit retention examples.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- "We need parity across languages — German contracts are just as important as English."
- "If recall drops in French by more than a couple points we can't cert this for EU legal discovery."

POC acceptance criteria (proposed):
- index 20M docs, run 100k test queries across 12 languages.
- achieve per-language recall@10 within 2% of English.
- P95 latency under 150ms for retrieval + top-100 rerank on Dedicated staging.
- cost < $0.005/query during POC at 5-10 qps sustained.

Technical notes / asks for Redwood team:
- run per-language eval harness; provide per-lang precision/recall CSVs and confusion matrix.
- report ANN index size and per-node memory for proposed Dedicated config.
- show fallbacks: lighter-weight reranker (distilled) options vs full cross-encoder for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- recommend quantization profiles and whether on-the-fly quantized kernels are available in Private deployment.

Next steps (short):
- deliver SOW + DE data residency addendum by 2026-03-10.
- agreement on pilot resource sizing (Maya to propose nodes).
- customer to provide 20M sample by 2026-03-20.
